thesisQuality.basis: Strong installed smart-water/AMI adoption, SaaS growth and portfolio expansion support durable demand, but acquisition-led value capture is not fully proven.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: FY2025 record sales/cash flow were strong, but Q2-2026 sales fell 7% YoY, operating earnings fell 12%, and margin declined to 17.7%; mixed/unproven band is warranted.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: September 2026 market capitalization near $3.7B is materially below prior-year levels, but current earnings/growth evidence does not establish exceptional asymmetry; balanced mixed band.

catalystScore.basis: Awarded AMI deployments, reiterated long-term growth framework and UDlive international expansion are identifiable catalysts, with timing and integration uncertainty.

governancePower.basis: Long dividend-growth record, expanded repurchase authorization and cash-funded acquisition indicate disciplined capital-allocation capacity; long-duration stewardship evidence is strong but not exceptional.

alignment2036.basis: Water measurement, leakage/network monitoring and wastewater observability address durable critical-infrastructure and resource-efficiency needs across plausible 2036 futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: BlueEdge reuses sensing, communications, analytics and utility relationships across metering, water quality, stormwater and sewer monitoring, though utility water remains the dominant demand system.

bottleneckControl.basis: Competitive pilot wins, installed AMI systems and high UDlive tender success indicate meaningful qualification/switching friction, but BMI does not control an irreplaceable system bottleneck.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Water infrastructure demand is durable and the portfolio spans multiple monitoring layers/geographies, but municipal project pacing and procurement remain common exposure.

substitutionResilience.basis: Integrated meter/radio/SaaS and sewer-monitoring portfolios create moderate replacement barriers, but alternative interoperable metering/analytics platforms remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: 2025 execution navigated global trade conditions, but current evidence does not establish tested multi-source redundancy or exceptional vertical control; conservative mixed band.

pricingPower.basis: FY2025 base operating margin expanded 200 bps and software-enabled mix improved gross margin, supporting meaningful value capture despite Q2-2026 margin normalization.

riskEvidence.basis: Material but non-thesis-breaking risks are project pacing, acquisition integration, valuation expectations, substitution and downstream utility execution; strong balance-sheet/cash evidence tempers severity.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Identity/tradability are validated and fresh issuer Q2, FY2025, acquisition and capital-allocation sources cover most underwriting dimensions; confidence is reduced for issuer concentration, incomplete supply-chain detail and limited independent operating corroboration.

scoreRecord.thesis: Badger Meter is a profitable smart-water infrastructure platform with expanding recurring software and sewer-monitoring capabilities positioned against durable water-efficiency and infrastructure-modernization needs.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Project pacing and acquisition-led expansion could expose weaker organic growth or integration economics while the market continues to price BMI as a quality compounder.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Execution of awarded multi-year AMI deployments and evidence that UDlive/SmartCover expansion converts into durable organic/cross-sell growth and margin recovery.
